kind: Normalized summary checked against downloaded GitHub Actions artifacts; not a security audit

results.limitation: Fresh generic Hardhat instance with explicit ArbSys block-number shim, not the public network
Fresh generic Hardhat instance; native-USDC and its ERC-20 balance view are not modeled here

assertionsCovered: same-transaction exact fee and locked-input seed binding
unused funding is backed credit owned by its authorized payer
fee changes inside and outside explicit maximum
no spending another round's existing credit
only controller authorizes and only configured payer funds
payer, fee maximum and input digest are immutable per authorization
withdrawal authorization, recipient rejection and reentrancy
real source-level proof verification and authenticated result storage
same round cannot be rerolled after accepted request or expiry
full and partial service refunds with snapshotted ratios and rounding
out-of-order refunds isolated to per-request accounts
provider refund-credit recovery after explicitly injected local recipient failure
forced native value and fixture token balances do not become operating credit
per-round conservation: provided + refunded = charged + credit + withdrawn
